title: Surf model contract
description: The boundary between the application and the surf model. Shared by packages/model (TypeScript) and swellkit (Python); both sides validate against this file so a field rename cannot drift silently. Everything is plain JSON — no dates, no language-specific types — because the model is intended to be reachable over a pipe.

tone.description: Condition label, ordered smallest to largest. Banded on breaking face height in feet: flat under 2, small to 4, solid to 6, large to 9, xl to 12, xxl above. 6ft is head high, 12ft double overhead.

isoUtc.description: ISO 8601 in UTC with milliseconds, as JavaScript's toISOString emits.

nullableNumber.description: Null means the instrument reported no value. It is never a zero.

steepness.description: NDBC's own sea-state classification, from the station's .spec file. A steep sea is already breaking offshore, which is where the breaking-height estimate loses its footing.

systemKind.description: Which wave system a figure was derived from. 'total' means the station published no partition and the undecomposed sea was used.

waveSystem.description: One wave system — a groundswell train or a local wind sea — with its own height, period and direction. NDBC partitions the spectrum into exactly these two; a model would give more. Null means the station published no partition, not that the system is absent.

height.description: Metres, significant height of this system alone. Systems combine in quadrature, so swell and wind wave squared sum to the total squared.

period.description: Seconds. The period of this system, which is the whole point of partitioning: a blended dominant period describes neither a 16s groundswell nor 5s chop.

observation.description: One buoy reading. Wave direction is whence the swell comes, not where it goes.

windWave.description: The local wind-sea partition, from WWH/WWP/WWD.

weight.description: How much one observation contributed. Carries no station name — attribution is the application's job.

facing.description: Degrees true the break faces. Absent means no directional weighting.

swellPower.description: Dimensionless index, H squared times T. Also the input to the breaking-height estimate.

faceHeight.description: Metres. Estimated breaking face height, trough to crest, which is the convention surf reports use. Derived from the offshore height and period, so it differs from waveHeight by roughly 1.25 to 2.0 depending on period.

faceHeightMax.description: Metres. The highest tenth of breaking waves, about 1.27 times faceHeight. Pair with faceHeight to report a range, since significant height is already a distribution.

faceFrom.description: Which system produced faceHeight. Each system is shoaled at its own period and the larger face wins, so a 2m 8s wind sea can outrank a 1.3m 10s groundswell and the client can say which it is.

swell.description: The blended groundswell partition. Weighted by distance and, when facing is given, by whether this system can reach the break.

windWave.description: The blended wind-sea partition. Weighted independently of swell, because the two arrive from different directions.

steepness.description: From the most influential station rather than blended, since the categories do not average.

observedAt.description: Earliest observation in the set. A reading is only as fresh as this.
